title: Auction Preparation Days for Heavy-Duty Models and Vans — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
Heavy vehicles need more preparation before auction. For a vehicle repossessed under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract, the preparation days follow the vehicle description printed on the contract and the vehicle's age: the whole years from January 1 of the model year to the mailing date of the notice of intent to sell, a year counted only once it is complete.

| Vehicle | Preparation days added |
|---|---|
| A heavy-duty model (HD) or a van, no more than 5 years old (the newer-model years) | 7 (the newer heavy-preparation days) |
| A heavy-duty model (HD) or a van, more than 5 years old | 4 (the older heavy-preparation days) |
| Any other vehicle | none |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical)**

- A van whose model year is five years before the year of the mailing date: age 5, 7 days.
- An HD pickup whose model year is six years before, notice mailed on 1 January: the sixth year is complete, 4 days.
- A sedan of any age: none.
